name: realistic-cost
description: Realistic human-engineering-team cost estimator. Computes what a 100% human-driven team would cost across all job functions (EM, backend, frontend, design, QA, PM, DevOps, security, data, tech writing) and the real-world calendar time the work would take.

scripts.test: node --test --import tsx test/smoke.test.ts test/estimate.test.ts test/cost.test.ts test/rates.test.ts test/transcript.test.ts test/cli.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
